quant_audit.issue: validate_quant_candidate checks CONFIRMED/non-empty facts/primary source_kind but does not call validate_observation_provenance; malformed or chronologically invalid primary provenance can therefore enter confirmed quant input.
quant_audit.proposed_fix: Reuse sources.validate_observation_provenance for every observed_fact; add regression cases for missing provenance, invalid timestamp, as_of > retrieved_at, future retrieved_at, and valid provenance.
quant_audit.reason: No validated historical sample/backtest/walk-forward evidence was found; do not fabricate probability.
